bib.title: RoFormer: Enhanced Transformer with Rotary Position Embedding

question: How can positional information be injected into transformer self-attention so that it is relative, flexible in sequence length, decays with distance, and works with linear attention?
hypothesis: Encoding absolute position with a rotation matrix makes the query-key inner product depend only on relative position, which should improve on additive position encodings and converge faster.
contributions: Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE): multiply query/key by a position-dependent rotation matrix, with a theoretical derivation
Show RoPE's inner product decays with relative distance and that it can be combined with linear attention
Evaluate RoFormer on translation, BERT-style pre-training, GLUE, Performer language modeling and Chinese long-text matching

method.summary: RoPE rotates each 2D pair of the query and key vectors by an angle m*theta_i (m = position), so q_m^T k_n depends on n-m. It replaces the position encoding in a transformer (translation), BERT (MLM pre-training), Performer and WoBERT (Chinese), and is compared to the original position encodings.

results.claim: RoFormer slightly beats Transformer-base on WMT14 En-De BLEU.
results.setup: WMT 2014 En-De, same settings, single run

results.claim: RoFormer does not beat BERT on all GLUE tasks: it wins MRPC, STS-B, QQP but loses SST-2, QNLI, MNLI.
results.setup: GLUE validation, fine-tune 3 epochs, bs 32, lr 2-5e-5
results.note: Text says RoFormer 'can significantly outperform BERT in three out of six datasets'; table also shows lower RoFormer scores on SST-2 (90.7 vs 93.5), QNLI (88.0 vs 90.5), MNLI (80.2/79.8 vs 84.6/83.4).

limits: Authors concede no thorough explanation of why RoFormer converges faster than other position encodings
Authors concede no faithful explanation of the superior long-text performance despite long-term decay being shared with other methods
Single-run results, no variance; GLUE results are mixed (loses 3 of 6 to BERT)
No extrapolation-beyond-trained-length test; long-text claim rests on one Chinese dataset where RoFormer-1024 is compared only to 512 baselines
Long-term decay shown only numerically (Fig 2), the proof sketch bounds a sum, not monotone decay
Applied to encoder/MT and Performer, no decoder-only LLM experiments

f_{q,k}(x_m,m)=R^d_{Theta,m} W_{q,k} x_m ; Theta={theta_i=10000^{-2(i-1)/d}, i in [1..d/2]} ; q_m^T k_n = x^T W_q R^d_{Theta,n-m} W_k x
